name: parse_posting_plain_digits
spec_quote: `https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<Company>/<digits>` optionally followed by `-<slug>`, `/`, `?…` or `#…` (digits: 6 or more) → {"company": <Company>, "id": <digits>}.

name: parse_posting_digits_with_slug
spec_quote: `https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<Company>/<digits>` optionally followed by `-<slug>`, `/`, `?…` or `#…` (digits: 6 or more) → {"company": <Company>, "id": <digits>}.

name: parse_posting_careers_host_http_with_query
spec_quote: Also host `careers.smartrecruiters.com`. http or https.

name: parse_posting_digits_trailing_slash
spec_quote: `https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<Company>/<digits>` optionally followed by `-<slug>`, `/`, `?…` or `#…` (digits: 6 or more) → {"company": <Company>, "id": <digits>}.

name: parse_posting_oneclick_ui_lowercase
spec_quote: `https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/oneclick-ui/company/<Company>/publication/<uuid>` (uuid = 36 chars, hex and dashes, any case; anything may follow) → {"company": <Company>, "uuid": <uuid in lower case>}.

name: parse_posting_oneclick_ui_uppercase_trailing_path
spec_quote: `.../publication/<uuid>` (uuid = 36 chars, hex and dashes, any case; anything may follow) → {"company": <Company>, "uuid": <uuid in lower case>}.

name: parse_posting_five_digits_null
spec_quote: Anything else (other hosts, fewer than 6 digits, missing parts, "oneclick-ui" used as the company with digits) → null.
